description: This file defines the Scala class `DiagnosticBusLogging` which extends `BusLogging` and mixes in `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter`. It is used for logging within the Akka framework, specifically combining bus logging with diagnostic logging capabilities, mainly for Java interoperability.

classes.description: A Scala class that extends Akka's BusLogging and mixes in DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for enhanced logging capabilities in Java.
